primary_route: Proposed acute isogenic p53 depletion and near-endogenous rescue, separate caffeine perturbation, longitudinal and fixed cell-cycle/death measurements.

checks.quote: All experiments below are **proposed**; no new data are being reported. The recommended next action is a **calibration-first, same-background isogenic protocol** that compares p53-competent, acutely p53-depleted, and near-endogenously rescued cells under a **matched damage load**, using **live-cell fate tracking** plus fixed **DNA-content/nucleotide-incorporation** readouts and explicit **death measurement**. The primary inference should be based on a **death-adjusted, single-cell contrast of damage-induced suppression of S-phase entry**, not on bulk DNA synthesis alone.
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select conditions and check transfer to this system.

checks.quote: selected during feasibility assessment
checks.reason: The core acute-depletion implementation and quantitative engineering/assay preparation are not resolved by a concrete procedure.

checks.quote: Calibrate live-death labeling
checks.reason: No objective death-detection reference accuracy/acceptance or DNA detector calibration; no-analog/S-phase controls alone do not complete independent measurement calibration.

checks.quote: mutually exclusive fate
checks.reason: The listed entered-S, died-after-S and divided fates overlap unless a hierarchy is specified; unknown/lost trajectories also lack bounded missing-fate handling in the original-cohort estimand.

checks.quote: minimum number of tracked cells
checks.reason: Pilot planning sizes tracked cells, not the number of independent treatment cultures/replicates needed for precision or power.

checks.quote: confidence or credible intervals
checks.reason: No actual multiplicity/gatekeeping or interval-based equivalence procedure for the primary rescue, necessity and restoration claims.

checks.quote: matched load must be operationally defined
checks.reason: Viability, morphology, density and phase distribution do not identify initial DNA lesion burden. Retitrating genotype-specific doses to match these downstream responses can erase p53 effects; admitting approximation does not meet the matched-load requirement.

checks.quote: within a prespecified range
checks.reason: No actual bounds or rule deriving that range for damage/caffeine/depletion exploration.
